source_candidates.content:
Diabetes medication follow-up
The patient has established type 2 diabetes. The previously prescribed adjustment of the glucose-lowering regimen was started on 2026-08-10; this was confirmed with the patient today. The prior HbA1c was collected on 2026-07-22. I am ordering another HbA1c for 2026-09-22 to assess response after this treatment change.
Electronically signed by Dr. Simulated Provider, 2026-09-15.
